ClosePaw RC11 058a — local validation report
Date: 2026-09-15

Purpose
- Preserve the installed 058 Generic Runtime Project Orchestrator.
- Fix the real-device regression where a one-line "Stop when ... is visible" clause was not parsed.
- Prevent model-selected actions after a locally proven terminal goal.
- Bound the PLAN_ACCEPT -> RC11 transaction gap so pre-dispatch work cannot silently suspend indefinitely.

Baseline / isolation
- Exact 057a verified full-source used as reconstruction baseline.
- Combined 058a patch fresh-applies with `git apply --check`: PASS.
- `git diff --check`: PASS.
- Fresh-applied source equals 058a postpatch source manifest byte-for-byte: PASS.
- 058 generic orchestrator implementation files intended to remain unchanged are byte-identical to the prior 058 manifest: PASS (7/7 checked).
- All 057a files outside the explicit 058/058a allowlist remain byte-identical by manifest audit: PASS.

Targeted correctness
- One-line goal `Open Settings. Go to Apps. Do not change any setting. Stop when Apps settings page is visible.` parses as PAGE_REACHED: PASS.
- Apps header proves that typed page postcondition while clickable child rows do not substitute for the page proof: PASS.
- Negative `Do not stop when ...` is not promoted into a terminal condition: PASS.
- Standalone GoalPostcondition harness: V58A_GOAL_HARNESS_PASS.
- Post-plan timeout is typed as attempted=false while owner cancellation remains CancellationException control flow: PASS.
- Standalone post-plan guard harness: V58A_POST_PLAN_HARNESS_PASS.

Lifecycle / semantic guard
- Existing 057a RC11 PREPARED -> ATTEMPTED transaction code remains present.
- Existing V54 cancellable HTTP bridge remains present.
- Post-plan completion + lease refresh is wrapped by PostPlanGuardV58A with 15s hard deadline.
- Timeout before ATTEMPTED feeds the existing bounded safe-pre-dispatch replan budget; no blind replay.
- A fresh local terminal check runs immediately before every model-selected nonterminal side effect.
- If the user's stop goal is already ACHIEVED, the model action is blocked and task completes locally.
- New diagnostics: POST_PLAN_GATE_V58A and MODEL_ACTION_TERMINAL_GUARD_V58A.

Packaging
- applicationIdSuffix intentionally remains `.rc11c058` to allow in-place upgrade over installed 058 and preserve Android permission/settings continuity.
- versionNameSuffix becomes `-rc11-c058a`.
- label becomes `ClosePaw RC11 058a`.

Workflow validation
- YAML parse: PASS.
- All bash `run` blocks `bash -n`: PASS.
- Embedded combined patch is byte-identical to standalone patch: PASS.
- Workflow patch simulation on exact 057a + manifest comparison: PASS.
- Multidimensional frozen-invariant/orchestration/058a static audit: PASS.

Not claimed locally
- Android Gradle compile/test/assemble cannot run in this container because Gradle 8.11.1 distribution is not cached and network access to services.gradle.org is unavailable.
- The provided GitHub workflow gates baseline compile, targeted tests, frozen navigation/lifecycle regressions, full unit suite, assemble, source identity, package/version/label, and APK signature.
- Real-device runtime acceptance remains required after the GitHub workflow is green.
